title: tk catalog tools record (tools.json beside a server.json)
description: The tools a server entry advertises, recorded by the library so the catalog-wide name check, the annotation check and the outputSchema check can run without connecting to the server. Each item is the MCP Tool shape (modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/tools: name, title, description, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations). Docker's catalog keeps the same idea in servers/<name>/tools.json. `source` says how the list was obtained and when; the list is a record, not a promise (plan R7). The contract's _meta object has no tools field (additionalProperties false), so this sibling file holds them; see the lane E status doc, requests for integration. Lane E, 27 Oct 2026.

source.description: Where the names came from: a tools/list answer, the server's docs or source, or observed through a client

dynamic.description: True when the server adds tools at run time (the computer-use server passes the helper's runtime tools through), so the list is the known static part only
